requirements.text: BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent work experience.
2+ years of experience developing software applications or services.
Solid grasp of software engineering fundamentals and their practical application.
Strong coding skills in one or more object-oriented languages: Java, Python, or TypeScript.

Hands-on exposure to Generative AI — e.g., building with LLM APIs, prompt and context engineering, RAG/retrieval, or agent frameworks — through work, internships, or substantial personal projects. Production experience is a plus, genuine fluency and curiosity are required.
Proficiency using AI-assisted development tools (coding agents and assistants) as part of your daily workflow, with the judgment to verify what they produce.
An understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and experience with web services (REST/JSON) and API integrations.
An understanding of unit testing and Test Driven Development (TDD).
Working knowledge of SQL and data fundamentals; exposure to data processing tools (e.g., Spark, Kafka) is a plus.
